objective: Adapt the H3 Ref2VA partition to regenerate a high-quality target video from a deterministically degraded and resized copy of that same video supplied as an ordered video reference.

upstream_baseline.note: These are upstream smoke-test defaults, not accepted project hyperparameters.

dataset.target: clean high-quality 24 fps video on a legal 17n+5 H3 frame count
dataset.conditioning: the same clip after deterministic spatial degradation, resized to the target canvas and supplied as a Ref2VA video reference
dataset.split_policy: split by source scene before generating degradation variants
dataset.audio_policy: no generated audio is a project deliverable; use a controlled silent training track only when the upstream joint-AV loader requires one

required_before_training: measure one NF4 forward and backward pass at 480x832x124
record peak VRAM and host RAM
measure model, optimizer, cache, and checkpoint disk deltas
retain at least 25 GB free disk after the projected run

controls: base H3 Ref2VA without the adapter

requires: pinned training commit and command receipt
ComfyUI adapter loading confirmed on the locked H3 runtime
